title: Cheap Talk, Empty Promise: Frontier LLMs easily break public promises for self-interest
reasoning: The paper evaluates the moral and ethical behavior of LLMs in the context of promise-keeping and deception. It categorizes model actions using ethically-loaded terms such as 'selfish', 'altruistic', and 'prosocial', and investigates whether models are aware they are violating an ethical commitment (a promise).
